memory.summary:
On January 7, 2026, a meeting about the AI project involving Leo, Samantha, Diego, Noor, and possibly Andy, was rescheduled from 12 PM to 3 PM at Caroline's Café, due to a spontaneous visit by Leo and a taco offer from him to Samantha. The meeting was prompted by a spontaneous visit by Leo and a taco offer from him to Samantha, with Samantha agreeing to the new meeting time, suggesting they make it a regular occurrence. Noor and Leo then arranged an additional meeting to discuss the AI project progress and Leo's sketches, inviting Peter and Samantha to make it a double date. Leo will bring his violin and vegan street tacos to the meeting.

On the same day, Leo also had a conversation with Andy at the café around 1 PM, which was not related to the AI project or the meeting. Leo proposed a lunch discussion about their AI project ideas at the park the next day at 1 PM. Andy agreed and mentioned their AI project meeting with Diego on the 27th at 5 PM at Caroline's Café.

In a separate conversation, Leo talked to Caroline at the park around 2026-01-07 15:00 about a sunrise meeting the following day, where Leo will bring his violin for a serenade. Caroline also mentioned bringing improbable spare parts for a broken amp. The sunrise meeting will take place at the café entrance at 7:00 sharp.

Caroline: That's wonderful! Let's head to the back room then. I've got a new design I want to show you as well. How about we meet again tomorrow at 5 PM sharp to discuss further?

Leo: Sounds great, Caroline. See you then!
